freeze_statement: The #1166 thresholds and corpus were frozen at commit dd5dcd44ee91a2c93bfd24c29f189d8de32e87d5 (2026-11-27T16:52:56Z), before any campaign run; the freeze-time manifest was 0eaca24b. Two harness revisions followed before the final analyzable run: 834dc183 (pre-run staging fix, after an identity-only attempt-1 at 16:56:36Z) and 56b109c1 (pre-analysis / pre-final-run evidence-stem fix, after a complete attempt-2 at 16:59:18Z whose raw evidence exists but was not analyzed). This file's current content is the post-run governance/validity-hardening revision: it preserves the executed scientific hashes and records the timeline, attempts, and post-run supplements below.

harness_revision.outcome_exposure: Attempt-1 produced only identity.txt; no workflow artifact existed before this revision.
harness_revision.reason: Docker Desktop 4.94 crashed on `docker rmi` of the digest-only reference during the first staging attempt. No workflow artifact was produced; the identity-only attempt is preserved under docs/superpowers/audits/data/crossarch-1397/attempt-1-docker-stopped/. The arm script now supports CROSSARCH_STAGE=0 (operator pre-staged image, fail-closed architecture verification) and the orchestrator pre-stages without `docker rmi`.

harness_revision_2.outcome_exposure: Attempt-2 checkpoint/output evidence exists but no cross-arm comparison was made or used. The final analyzable run is at 17:01:00Z.
harness_revision_2.reason: The first complete two-arm run (attempt-2) produced intact checkpoints and outputs, but the harness named the per-workflow evidence files by the .oxoflow file basename (cross-arch-provenance-governed-a) instead of the frozen workflow name (crossarch-governed-a), so the analysis could not pair the evidence. Attempt-2 evidence is preserved under docs/superpowers/audits/data/crossarch-1397/attempt-2-stem-mismatch/ and was NOT analyzed as the campaign result. The arm script now derives the stem from the workflow declared [workflow] name, matching the frozen corpus keys; this revision was committed before the final analyzable run.

negative_control.role: excluded from the primary endpoint and every class statement; must differ across arms; identical output makes the campaign INVALID (harness failure)

outcome_exposure: The freeze manifest (0eaca24b) had no outcome exposure. Attempt-2 produced complete two-arm checkpoint/output evidence but was not analyzed for the campaign result because of the evidence-stem defect; its raw evidence is preserved under attempt-2-stem-mismatch. The final-run manifest (770ae8f2) was committed after attempt-2 and before the final analyzable run. The scientific thresholds, corpus, and analysis decision logic were unchanged throughout; the post-run hardening only adds sealed-hash, host-architecture, tool, and env-lock-identity checks.

post_run_hardening.reason: Independent review of PR #1444 found unmechanized validity checks and record-integrity wording. Post-run hardening: the analysis now asserts the sealed corpus/workflow/PR-06/MANIFEST hashes, host-arch versus container-arch, the wc tool version, image identity, and normalized env-lock digests; the arm script reads the image block from the corpus and records wc/docker/CPU; the orchestrator documents remote/local cleanup. Scientific thresholds, corpus, and observed hashes are unchanged.

supplemental_evidence.scope: Post-run host inventory (CPU/Docker version) and the wc version from the same pinned image. NOT part of the sealed run-time identity; cited in report sections 5 and 6.

thresholds.primary_endpoint: architecture-stable artifact proportion (artifacts with identical SHA-256 in both arms / artifacts produced in both arms)
thresholds.threshold_derivation: With N=24 and all artifacts identical, the exact lower bound is Beta.ppf(0.025, 24, 1) = 0.025^(1/24) = 0.857526, which clears tau_ARCH=0.80. The threshold is a campaign-level capability floor fixed by the planned N and the exact interval construction, not by an observed outcome.

any in-arm provenance verify mismatch or recorded-vs-independent hash mismatch
